body: did you know: the victim in "no body, no crime" is named este -- after este haim. taylor wrote it alone during a true-crime binge, sent it to haim, and they said yes on the spot. in 2023 they opened eras shows with it: este singing the song named for her own fictional death.
why: X-native (text-only, no media) version of the evermore "no body, no crime" did-you-know -- refills X, which has been dark since 07-26 while IG kept a daily cadence, so drafting both platforms this run rebalances the channel mix. Same sourced facts as the IG sibling, trimmed to the punchiest one (victim named after Este Haim + Este performing it live). Every claim traces to the vault evermore 'no body, no crime' item (Wikipedia + Rolling Stone). Song-lore only, outside every blocklist topic.
